testcase.name: Scenario: Find origin axes with different query capitalization: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:631:5
testcase.system-out: Scenario Outline: Find origin axes with different query capitalization ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its model browser contains X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis under Origin ✔ When the user opens browser search and enters "axis" ✔ Then the browser displays X Axis, Y Axis and Z Axis under Origin ✔ And the matching text is highlighted ✔ When the user clears the search and closes the empty search field ✔ Then the unfiltered browser tree is displayed
